title: Partner Order
description: A Partner Order as a Partner sends it in one HTTP request to the partner endpoint (UC-001). Trailhead Gear defines this format, the same for every Partner, so it allows no field it does not name (UC-001 BR-010). The schema says what can be read as a Partner Order (UC-001 A3); the Order Checks are not part of it, so that every failed check becomes a Rejection Reason (UC-003 BR-010).

orderId.description: Order Number the Partner gives the Order. `TG-` and four or more digits (UC-003 BR-002) and the Partner's Order Number Range (UC-003 BR-003) are Order Checks, not rules of this schema.

partnerId.description: Identifier of the Partner the Order is sent for. Checked against the Partner the API Key belongs to, UC-001 BR-002.

orderedAt.description: Date and time the Customer placed the Order at the Partner, with its offset; the sample uses UTC (`Z`), and no time zone is agreed with the Partners.

customerEmail.description: Email address of the Customer, when the Partner sends one. Personal data (C-021).

shipTo.description: Shipping Address. Its parts are not required here: a missing part is a Rejection Reason, UC-003 BR-007. Personal data (C-021).

country.description: Country code; the US or Canada is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-008.

lines.description: Order Lines in the Partner's order. Their number, 1 to 30, is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-005.

sku.description: SKU of the Product. Checked against the Product Catalog, UC-003 BR-009.

quantity.description: Number of items. 1 to 20 is an Order Check, UC-003 BR-006.

unitPrice.description: Price the Partner sent for one item, a JSON number in US dollars. Not used: the Catalog Price applies, UC-001 BR-006.
